description: This file defines the 'AOR_ReportsViewEdit' class which extends 'ViewEdit' in a SuiteCRM module related to AOR Reports. It handles the display and preparation of the edit view, including loading language files, generating JavaScript variables for UI elements, and fetching related conditions, fields, and charts from the database.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to manage the edit view of AOR Reports, including dynamic data loading and UI preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view for display by setting up CSS and JavaScript resources, generating JS variables, and preparing condition, field, and chart data.

methods.name: getConditionLines
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the condition records related to the current report from the database.

methods.name: getFieldLines
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the field records related to the current report from the database.

methods.name: getChartLines
methods.description: Retrieves linked chart records related to the current report.
